verdict.rationale: Scheduled sending is a fair question for an email-sending API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only immediate sends via the API, SMTP and SDK (simple, raw and templated messages), with no scheduled-send parameter and no cancel operation. Missing for 10: any documented future-delivery scheduling via the API, any documented cancellation of a scheduled send.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule an email for future delivery through the API and cancel it before it goes out
